intro:
Magic, minigames, and boys cute enough to cast a spell on you.
Play more, unlock more, fall harder.
description:
Welcome to a world that's equal parts glittery and gorgeous, where kawaii anime boys with magical powers are waiting to be discovered.

Bright colors, soft pastels, and boys so cute they make the whole world feel a little warmer.

Play through the minigames, rack up your score, and watch the gallery unlock one boy at a time. The better you play, the closer you get.

From sweet and shy magical boys to confidently magical ones, each boy has a personality all his own, and yes, they cheer you on while you play.

Ready to find your favorite?


Features:

● EVERY MODE, A REASON TO KEEP GOING: Test your mind and your reflexes while climbing the scoreboard. Every point counts toward unlocking more.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Your score unlocks the gallery. Every new image is a reward worth earning.

● KAWAII CHARACTER PERSONALITIES: Each boy reacts to your gameplay in his own way. Some are encouraging, some are playfully competitive.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: The ending you get depends on how you play. Some paths lead somewhere special.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Hit question 150 and unlock the secret scene that only the most dedicated players ever reach.


The magic world is full of magical boys worth discovering. Your gallery is waiting. Start playing and see who you find.

Are you ready?
